title: tc-sliding-indicator
description: A highlight that slides to the selected item of the buttons or links inside it.

variant.description: "underline" draws a bar under the selected item (beside it when vertical); "pill" fills its box behind the text

orientation.description: Which way the items run – a vertical underline sits at the items' start edge

hoverPreview.description: A faint ghost follows the pointer over the items, sliding the same way

items.description: A CSS selector for the items inside it; the default takes tabs, options, radios, links and buttons
